title: leucanthemum crassifolium
intro: Leucanthemum crassifolium, commonly known as Broad-leaved Oxeye Daisy, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. The health benefits of Leucanthemum crassifolium include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can be used to treat various health issues such as wounds, fever, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Leucanthemum crassifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
